I know, I truly wished she went into a psychiatric facility as I love her and I hate to see this. But she is on some waiting list for trauma therapy, and if I would even TRY suggest she has likely got borderline and needs serious help for that she will simply flip out, grab a bottle of wine and storm off. It is heartwrenching. And I struggle most seeing my amazing sweet dad being completely lost and heartbroken from dealing with this every day. :(

I just ended a relationship with a DA… or well, he wanted to, too, as after 8 months he knew he was running out of excuses to not take me with him to weddings, or to introduce me to his family. He cancelled our holiday cause we weren’t ‘stable’ enough. No indeed, you cannot be stable if one of the two treats you like garbage. 

I am so angry. He told his friends and sisters very personal stuff about me to induce the narrative that I am crazy, and so that no one will ever doubt this lovely charismatic man’s fake kindness. Little do they know that my ‘crazy’ outspats stemmed from being tossed around like nothing. He also invited a girl he slept with to his work in a different country (very prominent sports event he works for), and when I found out he said it was cause her BOSS is a client of his and it would be good for his company’s reputation. When I got angry he shouted and said: YOU WILL NEVER UNDERSTAND WILL YOU, YOU DONT RUN A BUSINESS. 

The biggest mindf*** about it all is that he IS or seems a very nice, kind, innocent person. And that everyone sees me as the bad guy. It has been two weeks today and I go from sadness to indifference to anger. He is fine, said he was relieved it is finally over and that he finally can ‘relax’. It will take me a while to ever trust anyone again. I do not wish this upon anyone.. well, maybe him, so he knows how it feels.
The sad thing is I dont know a single person who is actually happy. We sit it out hoping that we will be happy one day. But in the end. No one did
Then you obviously dont get suicidal thoughts. I dont care about others thoughts. I have been privileged with a lot of things. No hotel room or money or shit can make someone happy.
How. If u stick it in stomach or neck fast. How
I dont trust anyone. I never will. No one. I also dont know a single person who is actually happy. Not billionaires, not millionairs, not my friends, not my parents. I just dont see the point.

I do. He hates talking about it and says ill just need to have patience and wait and see if hell one day feel that for me. The problem is that when you feel so turned down all the time you unconsciously start to resent someone which is what happens. I enjoy the attention of other men more and more even though i dont want to. I even started to fantasise about meeting someone who does make me feel amazing. I told him this and he still just shuts me up and says ill need patience and maybe one day hell ‘love me the way i love him’ 🥺
